problem_text:
A logistics firm is tasked with delivering ten distinct categories of cargo, each necessitating passage through ten sequential checkpoint inspections before final dispatch. The revenue generated per ton for each cargo category is outlined as follows:
* For Cargo Alpha, revenue is 16.581 per ton
* For Cargo Beta, revenue is 6.021 per ton
* For Cargo Gamma, revenue is 15.059 per ton
* For Cargo Delta, revenue is 11.527 per ton
* For Cargo Epsilon, revenue is 8.009 per ton
* For Cargo Zeta, revenue is 8.066 per ton
* For Cargo Eta, revenue is 17.323 per ton
* For Cargo Theta, revenue is 15.156 per ton
* For Cargo Iota, revenue is 11.08 per ton
* For Cargo Kappa, revenue is 12.092 per ton

The inspection duration required per ton for each checkpoint is as detailed:
*For Cargo Alpha, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.49 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.981 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.145 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.333 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.943 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.78 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 0.776 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 consumes 1.519 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 consumes 0.344 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 10 consumes 1.582 (ton-hours)

*For Cargo Gamma, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.873 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.262 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.381 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.088 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.049 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.498 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.431 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 consumes 0.86 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 consumes 1.064 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 10 consumes 0.326 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Delta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.755 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.555 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.966 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.034 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.996 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 0.461 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.441 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 consumes 1.799 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 consumes 0.316 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 10 consumes 1.366 (ton-hours)

*For Cargo Zeta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.168 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.021 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.2 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.7 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.209 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.355 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.821 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 consumes 0.834 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 consumes 0.987 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 10 consumes 1.463 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Eta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.259 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.648 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.587 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.373 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.284 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 0.876 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.274 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 consumes 0.411 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 consumes 1.893 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 10 consumes 0.513 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Theta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.291 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.321 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.653 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.462 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.572 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 6 consumes 1.963 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 7 consumes 1.805 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 8 consumes 0.591 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 9 consumes 1.353 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 10 consumes 1.833 (ton-hours)

The cumulative inspection time allotted for each checkpoint is strictly limited:
* Checkpoint 1's total processing duration must not exceed 178.019 hours
* Checkpoint 2's total processing duration must not exceed 234.15 hours
* Checkpoint 3's total processing duration must not exceed 315.02 hours
* Checkpoint 4's total processing duration must not exceed 185.512 hours
* Checkpoint 5's total processing duration must not exceed 214.513 hours
* Checkpoint 6's total processing duration must not exceed 208.745 hours
* Checkpoint 7's total processing duration must not exceed 325.799 hours
* Checkpoint 8's total processing duration must not exceed 197.341 hours
* Checkpoint 9's total processing duration must not exceed 234.548 hours
* Checkpoint 10's total processing duration must not exceed 233.021 hours

Given the imperative that the aggregate inspection time for Checkpoints 1 through 10 must remain within their respective hourly budgets, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each cargo category to maximize total revenue.
